shelterCamping: Official sources state timber shelters at the start and end of Etapp 2.
Getgöl and Svarteström shelter coordinates are high-confidence and importable candidates, with dedupe against adjacent stages.
Borgberget ArkNat shelter is a connector/Ankarsrumsslingan facility, not a main-stage shelter.
fire: Trail manager says hikers must check current fire-ban status through SMHI, Länsstyrelsen, or municipality before lighting fires.
Shelter fireplaces may exist, but use is subject to personal judgement, drought/fire-ban status, and full extinguishing.
Västervik municipality says fire-risk forecasts use SMHI values and are updated daily during summer. Risk level 5E often coincides with fire bans.
Länsstyrelsen Kalmar distinguishes ordinary fire ban from stricter fire ban. Under stricter bans, fixed public fireplaces may also be prohibited.
waste: Current Naturskyddsföreningen guidance says there is no trash collection on Tjustleden and has not been for many years.
Older Etapp 2 PDF trash-bag references are stale compared with current trail-manager guidance.
campingRestrictions: Borgberget nature-reserve rules prohibit tenting more than one night in the same place. The main Etapp 2 route may briefly clip the reserve near Isgölen/Ankarsrumsslingan; GIS overlay should confirm before import wording.
Shelters are not bookable and must be shared.
openQuestions: Confirm proper GIS overlay of the main Etapp 2 route against Borgberget naturreservat.

dogsLivestockAndHunting.notes: Official section text says the route crosses smaller pastures and open grazed land. At Mjöshult, walkers who want to avoid grazing animals can follow the road to Mjöshult and the small road north back to the trail.
No Etapp 2-specific hunting notice found. General allemansrätt/hunting caution applies; do not disturb active hunting and respect signs or local instructions.

fireBanCurrentness.notes: No static current fire-ban status should be imported. Use policy/source links and require a live check near trip/import date.

terrainHazards: Minor roads around Mjöshult and Ankarsrumsvägen near Hjorted require normal road-walking/crossing caution.

The route includes pasture/stile sections, a bridge over the artificial watercourse between Hjorten/Långsjön, two bridges via Isholmen at Isgölen, old forest roads, water-edge walking near Lilla Flugen/Svarteström, and hydropower infrastructure at Svarteström.
Seasonal risks include grazing animals, wet/muddy passages after rain or spring thaw, slippery bridges/shore rocks, fire risk during dry periods, and possible storm-fallen trees or forestry damage.
